name: radarr
description: Radarr integration for your self-hosted movie PVR — search TMDB for films, add movies, browse your library, the release calendar, the download queue, and grab/import history, and manage monitoring, quality profiles, and root folders. Authenticates with your instance's static API key sent as the X-Api-Key header (Radarr Settings > General > Security); requires Radarr v3+ and the server must be reachable from Sophon's sandbox (LAN-only or VPN-only instances need a reverse proxy or tunnel).
author: Buildersoft LLC

fields.label: Radarr URL
fields.helpText: The URL of your Radarr server including port, without a trailing slash. Must be reachable from Sophon's sandbox — LAN-only or VPN-only instances need a reverse proxy or tunnel.

fields.label: API Key
fields.helpText: Found in Radarr under Settings > General > Security.

tools.name: radarr.search_movie_lookup
tools.description: Search TMDB (via Radarr) for movies to add. Returns title, year, tmdbId, and a short overview for each match.

tools.name: radarr.list_movies
tools.description: List all movies in the Radarr library with monitoring state, whether the file is present, year, and ids.

tools.name: radarr.get_calendar
tools.description: Get upcoming and recent movie releases from the Radarr calendar (cinema, digital, physical), optionally within a date window.

tools.name: radarr.get_queue
tools.description: Show the current download queue with status, time left, and download progress per item.

tools.name: radarr.get_history
tools.description: List recent grab, import, and download-failure events from Radarr history, paginated.

tools.name: radarr.add_movie
tools.description: Add a new movie to Radarr by TMDB id, choosing a quality profile and root folder, optionally searching for a release immediately.

tmdbId.description: TMDB id of the movie (from radarr.search_movie_lookup)

monitored.description: Monitor the movie for releases (default true)

minimumAvailability.description: When Radarr considers the movie available (default 'released')

searchForMovie.description: Start searching for a release right after adding (default false)

tools.name: radarr.set_monitored
tools.description: Turn monitoring on or off for a movie in the library.

monitored.description: true to monitor, false to unmonitor

tools.name: radarr.list_quality_profiles
tools.description: List the quality profiles configured in Radarr (id and name), for use with radarr.add_movie.

tools.name: radarr.list_root_folders
tools.description: List the root folders configured in Radarr with free space, for use with radarr.add_movie.
